items.raw_excerpt: For 25 years, afpop, the largest association for foreigners in Portugal, have hosted their annual exhibition. This year the event returns but with a new name – afpop expo.

items.raw_excerpt: Moving to Norway often comes with steep integration hurdles, particularly when it comes to breaking through the tight-knit local social circles. To help international residents build a sense of belonging, the founder of Unlock Norway has launched Welcome Week. Will you join the events?

items.raw_excerpt: Umlibo, a 5×2 m tapestry stitched by 41 women and two men in a remote village on the Eastern Cape coast, goes to auction in Cape Town on 15 September 2026. items.summary_en: The Umlibo tapestry was made by 41 women and two men in a remote village on the Eastern Cape coast. The 5 by 2 meter work carries the village's climate story. It goes to auction in Cape Town on 15 September 2026.

items.raw_excerpt: Asian Games organisers mistakenly played the North Korean national anthem ahead of a men's hockey match between Bangladesh and South Korea.

items.raw_excerpt: Taipei Zoo said Friday that two chimpanzees were able to escape from their enclosure Thursday because staff did not properly secure two doors.
